title: Upravljanje identitetom i pristupom
summary: Životni ciklus pristupa imovini, faktori i biometrija (FAR/FRR/CER), AAA, sesije, proofing, SSO i Kerberos, JIT, FIDO2/passkeys, federacija (SAML, OAuth, OIDC, SCIM), modeli DAC/MAC/RBAC/RuBAC/ABAC/RAdAC, PDP/PEP, provisioning, revizija pristupa, PoLP i servisni nalozi.
summary_en: The asset access life cycle, factors and biometrics (FAR/FRR/CER), AAA, sessions, identity proofing, SSO and Kerberos, JIT, FIDO2/passkeys, federation (SAML, OAuth, OIDC, SCIM), DAC/MAC/RBAC/RuBAC/ABAC/RAdAC models, PDP/PEP, provisioning, access review, PoLP and service accounts.
